description_for_model: VCHUKI is a premium Indian D2C menswear brand based in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. They sell cotton linen blend full sleeve shirts, half sleeve shirts, and short kurtas (hip-length, NOT traditional long kurtas). Price range ₹799-₹1099. Free shipping above ₹1599. 7-day returns. Handcrafted with 47 quality checks. Target: men 22-45 in India.
